title: Nestle - proposed acquisition of Pfizer Nutrition - Pfizer Inc

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline suspended. Former proposed decision date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 12 July 2012 delayed pending receipt of information requested.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties following ACCC's request for information on 5 July 2012. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC timeline suspended at the request of Nestle to allow it to provide further information. Former proposed decision date of 23 August 2012 delayed.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC timeline suspended to allow Nestle and the ACCC to continue negotiations on a draft s87B undertaking. Former proposed decision date of 11 October 2012 delayed.
Draft s87B undertakings proffered by Nestle. ACCC commenced market inquiries.
Closing date for submissions on the draft s87B undertaking from interested parties.
ACCC timeline suspended at the request of Nestle to allow it to provide further information. Former proposed decision date of 25 October 2012 delayed.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Nestle proposed to acquire Pfizer Nutrition, a global infant nutrition business, from Pfizer Inc.
body_sections.Market definition: Please refer to the attached Public Competition Assessment.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Please refer to the attached Public Competition Assessment.
body_sections.Undertakings:
Variation to Nestle Undertaking - on 17 April 2013, the ACCC consented to a variation to the Nestle section 87B Undertaking. The purpose of the Variation was to:
(a) incorporate ring fencing measures in relation to information obtained by Nestle relating to a licence agreement Nestle would enter into with the Approved Purchaser; and
(b) require Nestle to take all steps to ensure that any licence agreement entered pursuant to clause 5.4(b)(i) of the Nestle Undertaking does not terminate as a result of a breach of that licence agreement by Nestle, and to include a procedure for approval by the ACCC.
